description:
Schedule a one-time re-run of prompts for a site, N days from now, to see whether published fixes got the brand cited — typically get_fix_plan's verify_prompts, with its audit_id as the baseline. Nothing runs or bills now.

Billing: free to schedule; when it runs, 5–12¢ per engine check (33¢ per prompt on the four default engines, ai-mode 10¢) for each prompt × engine answered, and nothing else: a recheck writes no fix-it playbook (the baseline already has the diagnoses). estimated_cost_cents is that total if every check answers. If credit runs short then, only the checks the balance covers run and get_recheck reports out_of_credits.

Limits: at most 25 rechecks waiting to run per workspace, 25 prompts each; cancel_recheck removes one before it fires.

When to call: after the user has published fixes, to learn later whether AI engines now cite or mention the brand (engines take days to weeks; for an answer now, check_brand_citation).

Inputs:
  site_id — from list_sites; or domain instead.
  prompts — e.g. the plan's verify_prompts. Omit to re-ask the baseline audit's prompts (25 or fewer).
  days — 1–90, default 14.
  engines — optional; defaults to the four core engines, ai-mode is opt-in.
  baseline_audit_id — e.g. get_fix_plan's audit_id. Default: the newest completed audit of the site that asked these prompts; a prompt × engine it didn't answer is compared with the newest earlier audit that did.
  label — optional note.

When it fires: the daily scheduler (06:00 UTC) runs one fresh audit (no cached answers) on its first pass at or after run_at, once; no email or report — read it with get_recheck.

Returns { recheck_id, status: "scheduled", site_id, domain, label, run_at, prompts, engines, checks, baseline: {audit_id, completed_at} | null, prompts_without_baseline, estimated_cost_cents, charged_cents: 0, note? }. prompts_without_baseline (asked by none of the site's 25 newest audits) get an after-only result.

Example: { site_id: "…", prompts: ["best invoicing app for freelancers"], baseline_audit_id: "…" }

baseline_audit_id.description: Audit to compare against, e.g. get_fix_plan's audit_id. Default: the site's newest completed audit that asked these prompts.

days.description: Days from now to run it, 1–90. Default 14.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Defaults to the four core engines; add "ai-mode" for Google AI Mode (10¢/check).

label.description: Optional note, e.g. "after FAQ rewrite on /pricing".

prompts.description: Prompts to ask again (max 25), e.g. get_fix_plan's verify_prompts. Omit to re-ask the baseline audit's prompts.

name: schedule_recheck
title: Schedule a one-time recheck of prompts after publishing fixes
